'''John Lopez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Mesa tournament]] on 24 February 2001 with Kashyyyk Operatives & Wookiees, according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1782">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-mesa-az-2-24-01-time-to-play-the-gamed1782/ mesa-az-2-24-01-time-to-play-the-game], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-mesa-az-2-24-01-time-to-play-the-gamed1782/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
